description:
Convert an AutoCAD DXF file's contents to GeoJSON — e.g. "convert
    this DXF to GeoJSON", "AutoCAD drawing to GIS format", "DXF export from
    Civil 3D to GeoJSON", "extract only the UTILITIES layer from this DXF".
    POINT/LINE/LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE/ARC/CIRCLE/ELLIPSE/SPLINE/HATCH/MPOLYGON convert
    (curves tessellated into LineString/Polygon), TEXT/MTEXT become points
    with a `text` property, and block INSERTs are expanded at their real
    position/scale/rotation with ATTRIB values as properties; 3D solids and
    meshes have no 2D GIS equivalent and are skipped, not errored on.
    Every feature's properties.layer carries its DXF layer name (group code
    8). Pass `layer` to return only that layer's entities — see
    list_dxf_layers to discover what layer names exist first.
name: dxf_to_geojson
